ben_cone: official three_cone (faster = higher) vs NFL Break G, rank corr.
ben_shut: official short_shuttle (faster = higher) vs NFL Break G, rank corr.
bg_drop: per drill rep: rank corr. of Break G with the speed shed into the plant (entry minus slowest speed)
bgc: Combine vs NFL Break G, same receivers
bl_r2: baseline (log pick, 40, weight, NGS athleticism, TE) held-out R2, career SOE
cm: held-out inches of season SOE per sd of Cut Match (closer match = higher)
cm_brk: median NFL breaks behind a Cut Match
cm_n: receivers in the held-out Cut Match test
cm_rel: Cut Match gap with odd vs even NFL breaks, rank corr.
cm_reps: median drill reps behind a Cut Match
cuts70: graded cuts per receiver for reliability 0.70
dr2: R2 change from adding Break G, held out
exp50: observed correlation expected if the true drill-game correlation were 0.5
f1_n: receivers in Fig 2 and the transfer rows of Table 2
g_sd: 1 sd of true receiver Break G, in g
hl_d: SOE minus pick order, hit-rate points
hl_k1: SOE-forecast half: next-season SOE above zero
hl_mde: hit-rate difference (points) this back-test detects with 80% power
ho: held-out inches of season SOE per sd of true Break G (regression-calibrated score)
ipw: held-out Break G slope, inverse-probability weighted
match:
drill vs NFL Break G, same route family: Reps entered within 1 yd/s
of NFL entry speed
match_hitch: hitch-family drill reps that are matched
match_pct: % of drill reps entered within 1 yd/s of NFL entry speed
mult_k: Combine-side metrics tested against season SOE
n_main: receivers with Break G and NFL routes (held-out test)
nm_n: wide receivers eligible for the named table
price: % earlier draft pick per sd of Break G, same position
rel_7x1: reliability of a 7-drill Break G score, one rep each
rel_c: reliability of the Combine score, Fig 2 receivers
rel_main: mean reliability of the receiver Break G score, held-out sample
rel_nfl: reliability of the NFL Break G average (Spearman-Brown of odd/even)
spc: official 40 vs NFL top speed, rank corr
spt: drill vs NFL speed through the cut (each vs its league), rank corr.
two:
drill vs NFL Break G, same route family: Drills run twice
(mean of 2 reps)
vin_gap: median drill minus NFL entry speed, yd/s
